query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `bonuses` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `bonusType` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `bonusName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `bonusValue` int NOT NULL,
  `bonusTier` enum('starter','professional','enterprise','agency') DEFAULT NULL,
  `bonusStatus` enum('pending','claimed','delivered') DEFAULT 'pending',
  `deliveryMethod` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `claimedAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `deliveredAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `referral_clicks` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `referralCode` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `ipAddress` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `userAgent` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `referer` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `landingPage` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `convertedAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_models` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `category` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `price` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `modelStatus` enum('active','draft','archived') DEFAULT 'draft',
  `downloads` int DEFAULT 0,
  `rating` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT 0,
  `reviewCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `creatorId` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `model_purchases` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `modelId` int NOT NULL,
  `pricePaid` int NOT NULL,
  `purchaseType` enum('purchase','subscription','rental') DEFAULT 'purchase',
  `purchaseStatus` enum('active','expired','refunded') DEFAULT 'active',
  `expiresAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `model_reviews` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `modelId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `rating` int NOT NULL,
  `review` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
